notes: This is the FOURTH sample on this route (round-25 X41 first, round-26 X59 second, round-27 X53 third). It was taken independently, in a fourth window on the final build wave, with new instrument dimensions (64-way concurrency rung, error-path probes: unknown model, empty messages, malformed JSON body, oversized max_tokens).

Unlike round 5 (native model-registry rejection) and round 10 (402 insufficient funds), this round produced live concurrent worker artifacts and thousands of served completions, so the route resolved, dispatched and returned work.

Wall time here is a short-completion round-trip (max_tokens 64, non-streaming, through the local shim), NOT the TTFT/TPS figure a battery would produce; it is a liveness and load measurement, not a latency score.

The three clean-population definitions are reported separately because the error-path probes deliberately fail: clean_attempts (157/152) includes both control and error families; clean_population_only (155/152) excludes the temperature:0 controls only; wellformed_population (151/151 = 1.0000) excludes both and is the figure comparable to the first three samples.
